license_required.quote: Every contractor shall register with the department.

issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industries.

name.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industries.

type.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industries.

age_minimum.quote: the applicant is under 18 years old at the time of application

required.quote: An applicant for registration as a contractor shall submit an application under oath upon a form to be prescribed by the director

experience_source.quote: An applicant for registration as a contractor shall submit an application under oath upon a form to be prescribed by the director

interval_years.quote: A certificate of registration shall be valid for two years and shall be renewed on or before the expiration date.

exists.quote: Every contractor shall register with the department.

regulatory_model.quote: Every contractor shall register with the department.

credential_type.quote: The department shall issue to the applicant a certificate of registration upon compliance with the registration requirements of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: It is a gross misdemeanor for any contractor to: (a) Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor without being registered as required by this chapter

title_protection.quote: Every contractor shall register with the department.

scope_protection.quote: It is a gross misdemeanor for any contractor to: (a) Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor without being registered as required by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, offering, bidding, or performing work as a contractor without being registered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor without being registered as required by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, offering, bidding, or performing work while registration is suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise, offer to do work, submit a bid, or perform any work as a contractor when the contractor's registration is suspended or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a false or expired registration number to purchase or offer to purchase an advertisement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use a false or expired registration number in purchasing or offering to purchase an advertisement for which a contractor registration number is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transferring a valid registration to an unregistered contractor or allowing an unregistered contractor to work under another's registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Transfer a valid registration to an unregistered contractor or allow an unregistered contractor to work under a registration issued to another contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subcontracting to or using an unregistered contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subcontract to or use an unregistered contractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an unsatisfied final judgment against the applicant in an action based on work performed as a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant has been previously performing work subject to this chapter as a sole proprietor, partnership, corporation, or other entity and the department has notice that the applicant has an unsatisfied final judgment against him or her in an action based on work performed subject to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying information on the registration application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the department has determined that the registrant has falsified information on the application, unless the error was inadvertent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a valid unified business identifier number
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the registrant does not maintain a valid unified business identifier number

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain an active and valid certificate of registration with the Department of Revenue
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the registrant does not have an active and valid certificate of registration with the department of revenue

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation or revocation of surety bond or insurance policy leading to automatic suspension
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a contractor's surety bond or other security has an unsatisfied judgment against it or is canceled, or if the contractor's insurance policy is canceled, the contractor's registration shall be automatically suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certified by DSHS as a person not in compliance with a support order or visitation order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department shall immediately suspend the certificate of registration of a contractor who has been certified by the department of social and health services as a person who is not in compliance with a support order or a visitation order

bonding_required.quote: Each applicant shall file with the department a surety bond issued by a surety insurer who meets the requirements of chapter 48.28 RCW in the sum of $30,000 if the applicant is a general contractor or $15,000 if the applicant is a specialty contractor.

insurance_required.quote: At the time of registration and subsequent reregistration, the applicant shall furnish insurance or financial responsibility in the form of an assigned account in the amount of fifty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" includes any person, firm, corporation, or other entity who or which, in the pursuit of an independent business undertakes to, or offers to undertake, or submits a bid to, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, develop, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development, or improvement attached to real estate or to do any part thereof including the installation of carpeting or other floor covering, the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith, the installation or repair of roofing or siding, performing tree removal services, or cabinet or similar installation
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" includes any person, firm, corporation, or other entity who or which, in the pursuit of an independent business undertakes to, or offers to undertake, or submits a bid to, construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, develop, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation or other structure, project, development, or improvement attached to real estate or to do any part thereof

financial_responsibility_demonstration_m.quote: In lieu of the surety bond required by this section the contractor may file with the department an assigned savings account, upon forms provided by the department.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: Evidence of workers' compensation coverage for the applicant's employees working in Washington

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: At the time of registration and subsequent reregistration, the applicant shall furnish insurance or financial responsibility in the form of an assigned account in the amount of fifty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property, and one hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to any one person, and two hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to more than one person.

small_project_exemption_threshold_dollar.quote: Any work or operation on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts, the aggregate contract price of which for labor and materials and all other items is less than five hundred dollars, such work or operations being considered as of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature.

license_number_on_permits_required.quote: All advertising and all contracts, correspondence, cards, signs, posters, papers, and documents which show a contractor's name or address shall show the contractor's name or address as registered under this chapter.
